repos.description: :arrow_double_down: Dumb downloader that scrapes the web
repos.summary_zh: You-Get 是一个轻量级命令行工具，用于从互联网下载视频、音频和图片内容，尤其适用于无官方下载渠道的网站。支持 YouTube、优酷等主流平台，具备流媒体播放、字幕下载及网页图片抓取功能，依赖 Python 和 FFmpeg，是开源的网页内容抓取工具。
repos.summary_en: You-Get is a lightweight command-line utility to download media (videos, audios, images) from the web when no official download option exists. It supports platforms like YouTube and Youku, enables streaming playback, subtitle extraction, and image scraping, and relies on Python and FFmpeg as core dependencies.

repos.description: A full-featured download manager.
repos.summary_zh: Motrix 是一款现代化全功能下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent 及磁力链接。v2 基于 Electron+React+TypeScript 重构，采用 MDXP 协议实现浏览器扩展与 CLI 远程控制，支持 Docker 无头服务器部署，适用于桌面与 NAS/家庭服务器场景。
repos.summary_en: Motrix is a modern, full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links. v2 is rebuilt with Electron, React, and TypeScript, using the MDXP protocol for browser extensions and CLI remote control. It supports Docker headless deployment, ideal for desktop and NAS/home server scenarios.

repos.description: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载
repos.summary_zh: Proxyee Down 是一款基于 HTTP 代理和 Netty 的高性能开源下载工具，支持多线程分块下载，具备扩展功能以满足特殊需求。项目因 Java 客户端开发限制暂停维护，作者计划用 Go + Flutter 重写以打造跨平台、低内存占用的下一代下载器。
repos.summary_en: Proxyee Down is an open-source, high-speed HTTP downloader built on HTTP proxy and Netty, supporting multi-threaded chunked downloads and extensible plugins. The project is paused due to Java client limitations, with plans to rewrite using Go + Flutter for cross-platform, low-memory usage.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: LinkSwift 是一款基于 JavaScript 的网盘直链提取工具，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘、中国移动云盘、天翼云盘、迅雷云盘、夸克网盘、UC网盘及123云盘八大平台。用户通过浏览器脚本即可快速获取文件真实下载地址，跳过官方客户端的限速与繁琐操作，大幅提升跨平台网盘文件下载效率。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for extracting direct download links from major Chinese cloud drives, including Baidu Pan, Aliyun Drive, China Mobile Cloud, Tianyi Cloud, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123Pan. It enables users to bypass official client restrictions and obtain real file download URLs directly in the browser, significantly improving cross-platform download efficiency.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, Interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
repos.summary_zh: dio 是一个强大的 Dart 和 Flutter HTTP 客户端库，支持全局配置、拦截器、FormData、请求取消、文件上传下载、超时控制及自定义适配器。提供完整的 REST API 调用能力，适用于移动端和 Web 应用开发，具备高度可定制性和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: dio is a powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, supporting global settings, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file uploads/downloads, timeouts, and custom adapters. It offers full REST API capabilities with high customization and cross-platform compatibility for mobile and web apps.

repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fallback support. 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐(原声)。
repos.summary_zh: 抖音批量下载工具，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐及主页作品去水印下载。具备进度显示、自动重试、SQLite去重、完整性校验及浏览器兜底抓取功能，并提供跨平台桌面端应用（支持抖音、TikTok、YouTube），实现多链接队列与账号内容同步。
repos.summary_en: A practical Douyin batch downloader supporting watermark-free downloads of videos, galleries, collections, and music. Features progress display, auto-retry, SQLite deduplication, integrity checks, and browser fallback. Includes a cross-platform desktop app for Douyin, TikTok, and YouTube with multi-link queuing and account sync.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一款免费无广告的追剧资源聚合指南，人工精选并每日自动检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等117个资源，完全开源，支持社区共同维护与贡献。
repos.summary_en: A free, ad-free curated guide for streaming resources with manual selection and daily automated validation. Covers online streaming, TV apps, cloud search, torrent/磁力 links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources—117 resources total, fully open-source and community-maintained.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

repos.description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
repos.summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.description: 微信视频号下载器
repos.summary_zh: 微信视频号下载器是一款轻量级跨平台工具，支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，通过注入浏览器扩展实现一键下载视频号视频。无需登录或复杂配置，自动安装证书并启动代理服务，在微信 PC 端界面直接添加下载按钮，支持多画质选择，下载完成后自动展示文件信息，体积小巧且操作简便。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Channels Video Downloader is a lightweight cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that enables one-click downloading of videos from WeChat Channels. It automatically installs certificates, starts a proxy service, and injects download buttons into the WeChat PC client interface. Users can select video quality (e.g., xWT111, xWT98) and download files with metadata displayed post-download, offering a simple and efficient experience.

repos.description: SEX IS ZERO (0), so, who wanna be the ONE (1), aha?
repos.summary_zh: hardseed 是一个从草榴和愛城论坛批量下载种子与图片的自动化工具，支持代理配置、文件名安全处理及智能重试机制，适用于资源抓取与离线保存，操作简单且适配多平台。
repos.summary_en: hardseed is a batch download utility for seeds and pictures from CaoLiu and AiCheng forums, featuring proxy support, safe filename handling, and intelligent retry logic, designed for efficient resource scraping and offline archiving with cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go/React和WebRTC的端到端P2P文件传输工具，支持文件、文字传输及桌面共享，数据直连不经过服务器，具备端到端加密、响应式设计和Docker一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A secure, privacy-focused P2P file transfer tool built with Go/React and WebRTC, enabling direct file, text, and desktop sharing without server relay, featuring end-to-end encryption, responsive design, and Docker deployment.

repos.description: macOS Adobe apps download & installer
repos.summary_zh: Adobe Downloader 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 Adobe 应用程序下载与安装工具，支持多产品并行下载、版本与语言选择，并集成自动化安装与清理功能。通过内置 Helper 机制实现免密操作，无需用户干预即可完成 Setup 组件修改，确保合法官方渠道下载，适用于专业创意软件部署。
repos.summary_en: Adobe Downloader is a macOS-native tool for downloading and installing Adobe applications. It supports parallel downloads, version/language selection, and automated installation via a built-in Helper mechanism that eliminates password prompts. All downloads are from official Adobe sources, with full cleanup utilities for residual files, ideal for enterprise or personal use.

repos.description: 突破百度云限速合集，另外附带Baidu-Go、Tampermonkey、Proxyee-down教程。从此云端女友从不断线，有了这个它，忘掉那个她!
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供Aria2下载工具及百度网盘破解限速方案，集成BaiduPCS-Go、Tampermonkey脚本和Proxyee-down等工具，支持多平台下载加速，实现百度云资源高速下载，解决限速问题。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers Aria2 download tools and solutions to bypass Baidu Cloud speed limits, integrating BaiduPCS-Go, Tampermonkey scripts, and Proxyee-down for multi-platform accelerated downloads, enabling high-speed access to Baidu Cloud resources.

repos.description: 🐒一些修改自网络的油猴脚本 Some Tampermonkey scripts modified from the internet
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一系列基于油猴脚本（Tampermonkey）的自动化工具，多数脚本改编自网络资源，涵盖网页功能增强、界面优化及实用小工具。所有脚本均托管于GreasyFork平台，支持多语言版本，具备高安装量和良好用户评价，适用于提升日常浏览与操作效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts a collection of Tampermonkey user scripts, mostly modified from online sources, designed to enhance web functionality, optimize interfaces, and provide utility tools. Hosted on GreasyFork with multi-language support, these scripts boast high installation counts and positive user ratings, ideal for improving browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: 人教社电子教材下载器
repos.summary_zh: FreePEP是一款人教社中小学电子教材批量下载工具，内置全量780+教材目录与AES解密引擎，自动破解WAF滑块验证码。支持WebUI与CLI双模式，提供多线程并发下载、断点续传及高清PDF合成功能，可一键获取指定学段、学科、年级的全套教材。
repos.summary_en: FreePEP is a batch downloader for People's Education Press textbooks, featuring 780+ built-in titles and an AES decryption engine. It automatically bypasses WAF CAPTCHA, supports dual WebUI/CLI modes, multi-threaded downloads with resumption, and high-quality PDF synthesis for quick textbook access.

repos.description: A Gorgeous LoadingView (一个绚丽的LoadingView )
repos.summary_zh: GADownloading 是一个绚丽的自定义 Android LoadingView，无需图片资源，通过代码实现动态加载动画。支持成功/失败状态切换，提供丰富的自定义属性（颜色、线条、文本等），可自动调整尺寸。适用于下载进度展示，兼容 JitPack 集成与源码复制两种接入方式，强调纯代码实现与高度可定制性。
repos.summary_en: GADownloading is a visually stunning custom Android LoadingView that renders animations purely through code without image resources. It supports dynamic progress updates, success/failure states, and extensive customization via XML attributes. Designed for download progress indication, it offers JitPack integration or direct source copying, emphasizing code-only implementation and high configurability.

repos.description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

repos.description: Beautiful native macOS download manager for direct links, magnets, and torrents.
repos.summary_zh: Harbor是一款原生macOS下载管理器，基于SwiftUI构建，支持直链、磁力链接与种子文件下载。主打本地优先、隐私友好设计，提供批量添加、流量控制、Torrent预览等实用功能，完美契合Mac原生工作流。
repos.summary_en: Harbor is a beautiful native macOS download manager built with SwiftUI, supporting direct links, magnet links, and torrents. Local-first, privacy-friendly, and free, it offers batch queuing, traffic profiles, and Torrent preview for a seamless Mac-native experience.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: 一个基于 Nuxt.js 3 开发的小红书工具网站，提供图文，视频，评论 浏览与导出
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt.js 3 构建的小红书工具网站，支持图文视频内容浏览、评论导出及下载功能，集成多代理轮换与本地数据持久化，提供现代化 UI 与完整代理配置，适用于内容采集与数据分析场景。
repos.summary_en: A Nuxt.js 3-based tool for browsing, exporting, and downloading Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) content including images, videos, and comments. Features modern UI, multi-proxy support, local data persistence, and automated browser interactions via Playwright.

repos.description: A cross-platform skills manager for AI IDEs. Search marketplace, download locally, and install to Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and more with one click.
repos.summary_zh: Skills Manager 是一款跨平台 AI IDE 技能管理工具，支持聚合搜索 Claude、Cursor、Windsurf 等10+主流AI开发环境的技能插件，一键下载至本地统一仓库并通过安全符号链接快速安装，提供版本控制、批量部署和自定义IDE支持，显著提升AI编程助手的功能扩展效率。
repos.summary_en: Skills Manager is a cross-platform AI IDE skills management tool that aggregates search across major marketplaces (Claude Plugins, SkillsLLM, etc.), downloads skills to a unified local repository, and enables one-click installation into 10+ supported AI IDEs via secure symlinks. It features version control, bulk deployment, and custom IDE support for enhanced AI programming assistant capabilities.

repos.description: 🚀 8000+ Verified n8n Workflows. Free to download. Includes a self-hostable frontend to browse and search automation templates.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是经过验证的8000+个n8n自动化工作流的开源集合，提供可直接下载使用的JSON格式模板。包含基于Next.js 14构建的自主托管前端，支持按角色和集成智能搜索，涵盖营销、DevOps、销售和AI等场景。数据以JSON和SQL形式开放，支持本地部署，致力于让自动化技术普惠大众。
repos.summary_en: This project offers 8,000+ verified n8n automation workflows in JSON format, freely downloadable for immediate use. It includes a self-hostable Next.js 14 frontend with intelligent search by role/integration, covering marketing, DevOps, sales, and AI scenarios. Open-source data (JSON/SQL) enables local deployment, promoting accessible automation technology for all.
